questions.stem: What is the correct order of components in a reflex arc?

options.text: Receptor, relay neurone, sensory neurone, motor neurone, effector
Receptor, motor neurone, relay neurone, sensory neurone, effector
Receptor, sensory neurone, relay neurone, motor neurone, effector
Effector, sensory neurone, relay neurone, motor neurone, receptor

questions.explanation: The correct order of a reflex arc is: receptor detects stimulus, sensory neurone carries impulse to spinal cord, relay neurone passes it on, motor neurone carries impulse to effector, which responds.
